speaker: Geoffrey Hinton (interviewed by Scott Pelley)
event: CBS News, 60 Minutes: '"Godfather of AI" Geoffrey Hinton' interview with Scott Pelley
date: 2023-10-08 (CBS transcript page: first published Oct. 8, 2023; Sunday broadcast; YouTube upload 2023-10-09)
context: Interview recorded after Hinton's May 2023 departure from Google; CBS narration says he recently retired after 'what he calls 10 happy years at Google'.

lines.verbatim: So one of the ways in which these systems might escape control is by writing their own computer code to modify themselves.
lines.speaker: Geoffrey Hinton
lines.clip: /home/user/hyperplane-teaser/clips/hinton-escape-control-2023.mp4 (333.5-347.0 s, includes the follow-up 'And that's something we need to seriously worry about.')
lines.verification: small.en re-transcription of 300-390 s matches YouTube captions word for word; CBS transcript quote matches (CBS punctuates 'So, one of...').
lines.notes: Most explicit AI-control line. Self-contained, about 8 s; can be trimmed to 'these systems might escape control'.

lines.verbatim: Well, because they might take over.
lines.speaker: Geoffrey Hinton
lines.verification: small.en re-transcription of 650-770 s matches captions; CBS transcript quote matches.
lines.notes: Answer to Pelley's 'Can't afford to get it wrong, why?'. Follow-up exchange in the same clip: Pelley 'Take over from humanity?' (~709.6-710.7 s), then Hinton 'Yes, that's a possibility.' (~711.2-712.1 s). The Pelley question makes the 'take over' context explicit; the reply is punchy alone.

lines.verbatim: I can't see a path that guarantees safety.
lines.speaker: Geoffrey Hinton
lines.verification: small.en re-transcription matches captions; CBS transcript quote matches.
lines.notes: Risk rather than control; very short and quotable. Clip opens on Hinton's preceding 'I don't know.'

verification_method: YouTube auto/CBS captions used only to locate timestamps (VTT word timings). Audio re-transcribed with faster-whisper small.en on the 300-390 s and 650-770 s windows; word sequences match the captions for all quoted lines. Quotes also match the CBS transcript page.
caveats: Speaker attribution for the question lines (Pelley) comes from the CBS transcript, not from voice diarization; Hinton's answer lines are the quoted lines.
Air date rests on CBS's 'first published Oct. 8, 2023' and the Sunday teaser ('This Sunday on 60 Minutes', uploaded 2023-10-05); no broadcast log was checked.
Whisper transcribes 'connivances' where captions say 'connives' (not used in any candidate line).
Full interview is 13 min (792 s), under the 30 min cap; the file is the full video, the three trimmed clips are separate.
